aboutGame.title: What is Build and Conquer?
paragraphs: Build and Conquer is a Roblox city-building and modern warfare strategy game from developer group The Slop Company. Every match starts on an empty plot: you lay roads, connect power and water, zone housing and shops, and grow a population that pays taxes every pay cycle while mines, oil pumps and refineries feed the industrial chain behind your army.

As your city levels up you unlock coal and nuclear power, steel-hungry high rises, and a research tree that produces only military items — barracks, military factories, Sloparms offices, ballistic missile launchers, Patriot batteries and Iron Dome. From your first solar panel to a hypersonic strike package, this wiki covers every system with guides, data tables and step-by-step walkthroughs.

explore.title: Explore Build and Conquer Wiki
explore.description: From your first plot to missile silos and drone warfare, these Build and Conquer guides cover city levels, resources, research, air defense and the platform details every new mayor needs.

modules.name: Build and Conquer Beginner Guide
modules.description: First-session walkthrough for the Roblox experience: claim an empty plot, place a solar panel for power, connect water, add housing for workers, then open shops so the city starts earning money every pay cycle.

highlights.detail: Claim a plot on the 8-plot map, name your country and pick a flag — every match opens with an empty parcel and $2,500 in the treasury
Place the free wind turbine, water tower, starter barracks and research office first so nothing locks up before you spend a single dollar
Follow the 4-stud rule: every house, shop and utility must sit within 4 studs of a road or the placement ghost turns red
Sketch the city grid with $0 dirt roads, then upgrade only the busy corridors to two-lane roads at $10 per unit
Keep power and water grids separate — electricity cannot bridge across water installations, and pipes need a continuous path
Stabilise tax income before touching military research; the tech tree stays locked until the city reaches Level 2

modules.name: Build and Conquer Resources and Economy Guide
modules.description: How money, energy, water, coal, iron and oil move through the city: commercial buildings earn money, mines and oil pumps feed factories and refineries, and refineries turn crude oil into fuel for the war economy.

highlights.label: Money
highlights.detail: Commercial venues and populated residences pay cash every pay cycle, while every building quietly deducts its upkeep from the same balance

highlights.label: Power
highlights.detail: Solar Panels cost $100 for 20 energy and Wind Turbines $500 for 200 energy, and substations relay that current deeper into the plot

highlights.label: Water
highlights.detail: A $12 Water Tower covers 200 citizens in a 500x500 area, while the $5,000 Desalination Plant pipes the entire city

highlights.label: Coal
highlights.detail: The $5,000 Coal Power Plant burns mined coal for 6,000 energy, so stockpile fuel before you flip the switch

highlights.label: Iron
highlights.detail: Iron ore from community mines feeds the smelters that produce the structural steel used by offices and defense batteries

highlights.label: Oil
highlights.detail: Oil pumps supply crude to refineries, which convert it into the refined fuel that vehicles and missile programs consume

highlights.label: Steel
highlights.detail: Steel becomes mandatory from City Level 3 onward for city apartments, office towers and municipal precincts

modules.name: Build and Conquer Buildings and City Levels Guide
modules.description: Building categories, unlock levels, energy and water demand, steel requirements and the population-driven conditions that raise your city level and unlock new technology.

highlights.label: Level 1
highlights.detail: Settlement founding: houses and two story homes run on solar panels, wind turbines and water towers with no raw materials required

highlights.label: Level 2
highlights.detail: Suburban expansion unlocks coal power plants, the Sheriff's Office and banks, and switches on citizen happiness tracking

highlights.label: Level 3
highlights.detail: Urban densification brings city apartments and large supermarkets, but every new building now demands steel and a bigger workforce

highlights.label: Level 4
highlights.detail: Megacity infrastructure adds nuclear power plants, corporate high rises and a uranium draw of 1 unit per minute

highlights.label: Level 5+
highlights.detail: Superpower endgame layers advanced national defense on top of multi-resource supply chains and high per-cycle cash upkeep

modules.name: Build and Conquer Military and Research Guide
modules.description: Research only unlocks military items and buildings, and most of it is gated behind a higher city level: barracks, military factories, Sloparms offices, SRBM and MRBM launchers, Patriot batteries and Iron Dome.

highlights.label: Research
highlights.detail: Research exclusively unlocks military items and structures, and the tech tree will not open until your city level and population qualify

highlights.label: Barracks
highlights.detail: The starter barracks produces basic ground personnel and security crews that patrol the municipal core

highlights.label: Sloparms
highlights.detail: Small, Medium and Large Sloparms Offices push the tech tree from entry-level blueprints to advanced rocketry and guidance packages

highlights.label: Factory
highlights.detail: Military Factories assemble armored transports and basic munitions, while Large Military Factories mass-produce strike assets

highlights.label: Missiles
highlights.detail: Ballistic firepower follows an escalation ladder — SRBM launcher, then MRBM launcher, then hypersonic missiles unlocked by confirmed hits

highlights.label: Patriot
highlights.detail: Patriot batteries and Iron Dome interceptors give you the long-range and point-defense layers that keep a border city alive

modules.name: Build and Conquer Drone and Missile Warfare Guide
modules.description: Air warfare overview for the Roblox experience: Shahed drones, ballistic missile launchers and the Patriot / Iron Dome air-defence answers players use to protect a city from raids.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Iron Dome and Patriot PAC-3 layered over the city core, intercepting saturation drone swarms and heavy ordnance before they reach your commercial blocks

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Patriot Battery on the border perimeter, engaging MRBMs and high-altitude rockets early — just keep a backup power line feeding it

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Shahed loitering munitions, the one-way strike drones that breach fortified perimeters and gut power plants, refineries and command posts

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Scout drones: cheap, fast and fragile, best used to clear fog, reveal hidden missile pads and trigger anti-air coverage before the strike package commits

modules.name: Build and Conquer Roblox Platform Guide
modules.description: How to join the experience on PC, mobile, tablet or console through the official Roblox client, what a Roblox account needs, and why there is no separate APK or Steam build for this game.

highlights.label: Roblox
highlights.detail: Build and Conquer runs entirely inside the Roblox engine, so you launch it from the official Roblox client or web player

highlights.label: PC
highlights.detail: Play on PC through the Roblox desktop app or a browser; there is no standalone installer and no Steam release

highlights.label: Mobile
highlights.detail: The Roblox mobile app covers Android and iOS phones and tablets — no third-party APK for this experience exists

highlights.label: Console
highlights.detail: Roblox ships on Xbox consoles, so Build and Conquer can be played there with a controller layout

highlights.label: Account
highlights.detail: A free Roblox account is the only requirement: the experience itself costs nothing to join

highlights.label: Servers
highlights.detail: Each server hosts up to 8 players across an 8-plot map, so rival nations are building on the parcel next door

modules.name: Build and Conquer Codes and Community
modules.description: Where Build and Conquer codes and patch news actually appear: the official The Slop Company Discord and Roblox group, plus community wikis. No standalone official code portal exists.

highlights.label: None
highlights.detail: As of October 2026 the V0.1 beta has no redemption system deployed, so no promo code is active right now

highlights.label: BETA RELEASE
highlights.detail: A frequently searched phrase in code lists, but it is not an official Build and Conquer promo code

highlights.label: SLOPCOMPANY
highlights.detail: The developer group name that keeps appearing in third-party code lists — no in-game reward is attached to it

highlights.label: DISCORD
highlights.detail: The Slop Company Discord is the channel where patch notes and any future code drops are announced first

highlights.label: GROUP
highlights.detail: The official Roblox group posts update news, and community wikis track balance changes between patches

modules.name: Build and Conquer Tips and Strategy
modules.description: Community-tested habits from player guides: keep power and water ahead of growth, protect the economy before expanding the army, and check city level requirements before buying expensive steel-heavy buildings.

highlights.label: Power
highlights.detail: Keep power and water ahead of growth: a blackout or water shortage freezes population, workforce and tax income at once

highlights.label: Defense
highlights.detail: Protect the economy before expanding the army — an unfortified city loses its power grid and factories within minutes

highlights.label: Budget
highlights.detail: Check the city level requirement before buying steel-heavy buildings, or construction stalls halfway through and blocks your plot

highlights.label: Roads
highlights.detail: Lay free dirt roads while sketching the grid, then pave only the corridors that actually carry heavy traffic

highlights.label: Workers
highlights.detail: Every office and factory needs workers from housing, so balance residential density against your job count

highlights.label: Happiness
highlights.detail: Communal housing is cheap population but carries a happiness penalty; offset it with strip malls and supermarkets

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Build and Conquer on Roblox.

items.question: Is Build and Conquer free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Build and Conquer is a free Roblox experience from The Slop Company — there is no paid client, APK or Steam version, and you only need a free Roblox account to join a server.

items.question: Do Build and Conquer codes exist?
items.answer: Not yet. As of October 2026 the V0.1 beta has no redemption system deployed, so every code list you find online is either unconfirmed or copied from another game. Patch news appears on the official Discord and Roblox group.

items.question: How do I reach City Level 2 in Build and Conquer?
items.answer: Grow population to roughly 250 residents. Place dense mid-rise apartments on a compact utility footprint, keep power and water coverage high, and make sure every building sits within 4 studs of a road.

items.question: How do I make money in Build and Conquer?
items.answer: Commercial buildings and populated houses pay cash every pay cycle. Balance residential and commercial zones, avoid empty offices that still charge upkeep, and never let power or water fall behind growth.

items.question: Which platforms can I play Build and Conquer on?
items.answer: Any device that runs Roblox: PC through the desktop app or browser, Android and iOS phones and tablets through the Roblox app, and Xbox consoles. There is no separate download.

items.question: Do I need military research to defend my Build and Conquer city?
items.answer: Yes. Research unlocks barracks, military factories, Sloparms offices, SRBM and MRBM launchers, Patriot batteries and Iron Dome, and most of the tree is gated behind a higher city level.
